source.name: Lab 3.2: Creating Your First Flow (goodbye.yml)
source.instructions:
To pass this assessment, all of the following checks must pass:

• Check 1: `data/basics/goodbye.yml` has the correct flow structure.
source.guidance: Ensure `chapter1/data/basics/goodbye.yml` has `flows:`, `goodbye:`, `name:`, `description:`, `steps:`, and `- action: utter_goodbye`. Use 2-space indentation.

sequence.feedback: data/basics/goodbye.yml has correct flow structure (flows:, goodbye:, name:, description:, steps: with utter_goodbye).
